_doc: Friday 0DTE timing engine — the single config (spec v3 §35). Every tunable lives here; no magic numbers in code. Repo file = defaults; a copy at <data_dir>/thresholds.json overrides key-by-key (deep merge). The effective config's sha256 hash is stamped on every decision. Surfaced read-only in the tweaks panel.

risk._doc: Admissibility limits per position intent (§29). A future/current sale is admissible only while every limit holds. Amendment C: intent changes limits and costs, never the market model.
risk._breach_cost_doc: breach_cost_mult scales the terminal-intrinsic penalty charged to WAIT paths that die inadmissible (breached before any admissible capturable sale). Income-only: assignment is a failure, waiting near danger is expensive (2.0x intrinsic). Wheel-acceptable: assignment is tolerable economics — covered call = capped upside you already accepted, CSP = buying a stock you wanted at effective basis (0.15x).

simulation._doc: Monte Carlo core (§9). Seed derives deterministically from the decision id (Amendment B) so replay is byte-identical.

bands._doc: Score bands (§17): 0-20 strong wait, 21-40 wait, 41-59 getting close, 60-79 sell zone, 80-100 strong sell. Calibrated later from results.

score_weights._doc: §17: the score SUMMARIZES the stopping quantities, never replaces them.

hysteresis._doc: §34 + Amendment B: displayed state changes only past margin or persistence; margin must clear k× the Monte Carlo standard error so MC noise alone can never rattle the UI. Risk escalations are exempt and fire immediately.

attention._doc: §31: decisions are evaluated against the next realistic look, not the next minute.

tape._doc: §3 intraday option tape. Cadences in seconds; durable benchmark defined in SECONDS (Amendment E), converted to snapshots at the live cadence. Budget shares the app-wide Schwab 110 req/min self-cap.

final_hour._doc: §33: inside the window the question flips to close vs carry.

portfolio._doc: §30 + Amendment D: shared-shock scenarios; each position valued under the view matching its intent, then summed. weekly_max_loss_usd is the risk budget under the ±2% shared shock.

management._doc: §20. The 2x credit tripwire is model-free and stays armed by default.

tranche._doc: §13 dynamic tranching; cold-start fixed plan badged heuristic while confidence is low.

limits._doc: §14 seed rules until the fill distribution exists: Likely = credit at 70% of projected extension, Balanced = credit at projected extreme × 0.85, Stretch = credit at the 2.5σ VWAP band.

events._doc: §15: scheduled events are FEATURES that widen simulated ranges near their timestamps; optional per-class hard block windows (minutes before/after) in which decision states show BLOCKED.

clock._doc: Step 0.5 discipline: measured drift beyond the bound blocks decision states and says why.

session._doc: Hand-maintained early-close calendar (13:00 ET), treasury.py MACRO_SCHEDULE pattern: refresh before valid_through and extend the list.

intents._doc: §29: per-position intent set from the UI; key = 'SYM|kind' (e.g. 'MU|put') or 'SYM' for both sides. Unlisted positions use default.
